kitDescription: Ludmilla is a Water SMG Defender whose Burst I, Snow Queen, hits the boss once for 163.1% of her final ATK and, while she is above half HP, grants the whole team a small DEF buff for 10 seconds. Her first skill shaves the boss's DEF and ATK by 8.4% for 10 seconds every time she empties her magazine, which in real play is her main team-damage contribution because the DEF cut applies near-continuously. Her second skill triggers whenever the team enters Full Burst: she taunts all enemies for about 15 seconds and takes 57.86% less damage herself for 15 seconds. She is a tank whose kit is mostly defensive — aggro control, self-mitigation, and boss stat-downs — with only the burst hit and the DEF debuff touching the damage sheet. In the sim the boss deals no damage and runs with zero DEF, so everything except the burst nuke and the carried DEF buff is genuinely unobservable.

skill1.blindSaid: S6: ⚑ no schema channel, refused to launder into damageTakenPct; S5: it.skip GAP naming the missing boss-DEF StatKey.
skill1.formulaCheck: Boss DEF is a small flat subtractive term (≈140 measured, run at 0, ≤0.12% board shift) — the line is inexpressible AND zero-valued on this basis; the classification is a genuine documented gap, not a drop.
skill1.explanation: All three agents independently converge: the engine has no boss-DEF-debuff primitive and the basis runs bossDef=0. Documented with estimate + recipe + tier. S2b's FAITHFUL disposition assumed a working boss-DEF-debuff channel that the mechanics SSOT shows does not exist — that premise was wrong, not the driver.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas. The two load-bearing lines (burst nuke, boss DEF▼ disposition) are correct: the nuke is a single 163.1% burst-cast hit with no FB major, no core, no range, discriminated against the lv1-magnitude and ×10-multi-target misreads; the DEF▼ line is a DOCUMENTED_GAP — driver, S5, and S6 independently agree the engine has no boss-DEF-debuff primitive and the scope-lock basis runs bossDef=0, so the line is zero-valued and inexpressible rather than dropped, with estimate, recipe, and tier recorded. The kit's most dangerous line (self Damage Taken ▼57.86%) was checked by all three agents against the boss-damageTakenPct sign/channel trap and is clean; the zero-damageTakenPct guard is non-vacuous (the injected nearest-wrong moves team totals). S5's blind tests run GREEN against the shipped override 13/0-fail with the 5 skips being honest GAP declarations; S6's blind override is byte-equivalent to the driver's except an explicit noFb flag that the engine already forces — full cross-family convergence. S2b's one wrong premise (expecting the DEF▼ line to be modelable as FAITHFUL) was corrected by the mechanics SSOT itself and is noted, not a finding. Residual for owner spot-check: every agent read the same doc claiming applyEffect drops enemy ATK▼/DEF▼ debuffs — a same-model/shared-doc agreement; a 5-minute grep of sim.ts applyEffect would independently confirm that claim, and the datamined SMG cadence tuple (RoF 1440, reloadFrames 187) remains footage-unverified (⚑3).
